reviewScope: Black Whale vessel, spatial, access, operational, structural and scale evidence only

pass1.method: Full-page visual sweep of all 19 ordered pages

pass2.method: Full-resolution verification of numbered royal-suite thresholds, corridor depth, occupancy and security states

retainedPanels.subject: Guarded royal corridor
retainedPanels.visualDescription: A broad finished corridor supports a group formation and guarded movement.
modelingProhibitions: Do not infer exact corridor length

retainedPanels.visualDescription: Visible plaques identify additional numbered corridor-facing suites.
modelingProhibitions: Do not infer adjacency from montage order

evidence.claim: A broad finished corridor supports a group formation and guarded movement.
Multiple suite labels appear within the royal residential system.
The 1001 plaque identifies a corridor-facing royal suite.
Visible 1009 and 1011 plaques confirm additional numbered thresholds.
Guards and attendants cluster near room fronts while retaining passage space.
A group transitions through a tall doorway into the corridor.
A long empty decorated corridor shows repeated wall bays and ceiling modules.
A tall door and adjacent wall field establish a controlled suite entrance.
The 1013 plaque marks another royal-suite threshold.
Several guards occupy the corridor near numbered rooms.
Movement occurs along the corridor directly outside Room 1013.
Repeated ceiling bands align with repeated wall bays through the corridor.
The corridor permits multiple people abreast without single-file movement.

contradictionsAndQuarantines.subject: Numbered-room montage
contradictionsAndQuarantines.rule: Visible room numbers identify thresholds but editorial montage cannot establish exact adjacency or corridor order.

contradictionsAndQuarantines.subject: Empty corridor repetition
contradictionsAndQuarantines.rule: Repeated empty-corridor panels establish type and depth, not a measured length.

unresolvedQuestions: Are 1009, 1011 and 1013 on one continuous corridor segment?
What is the exact bay spacing?

excludedMaterial.reason: Excluded pages do not independently establish ship evidence.
